one_liner: Nifty 50 rises for the eighth session amid mixed market breadth.

drivers.title: FII inflows
drivers.detail: FIIs were net buyers with Rs 7,212.22 Cr inflow.

drivers.title: Pharma surge
drivers.detail: Nifty Pharma gained 1.65% leading sectoral gains.

flows_line: FIIs net bought Rs 7,212.22 Cr; DIIs net sold Rs 7,172.53 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for corporate actions on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
lesson_seeds: Nifty 50 continues its upward streak for eight sessions.
Market breadth was negative despite index gains.
FIIs showed strong buying interest in the cash market.
Sectoral performance was led by Pharma and PSU Banks.
